limitations: Trace timestamps normalized by Trace Processor; app elapsedRealtime millisecond boundaries carry sub-ms uncertainty.
CPU flamegraph is sampled on-CPU work, not a wall-clock latency attribution.
R8 class names restored where mapping matches; method names may remain obfuscated.
Frame timeline includes startup/transitions and target; use layer/process filtering for steady overlay conclusions.

withdrawnDrawingCandidate: postOnAnimationDelayed(24) reverted to original postDelayed(16); partial p95 benefit did not establish overall CPU, absolute-error or click-tail benefit.
limits: All default-1800-ms failures are retained; 4000-ms pairs do not replace them.
Latency percentiles contain successful samples only. Attempted, failed and not-attempted tasks are separately reported.
The first preliminary clock collection workflow included a host core test build; overlap with steady measurement is not established. Quiet control and candidate repeats are separate cohorts.
Small sequential cohorts are not randomized A/B. P99 is nearest-rank and equals max with 30 samples.
Only the target APK is identical across the drawing comparison; app APK differs intentionally by the drawing policy.
Independent HTTP midpoint comparison is an estimate and does not certify source accuracy or absolute UTC.
Drawing data reflects observed Canvas digits, not physical screen photon latency.
Source estimation is unchanged; no blind averaging, stale minimum-RTT anchor selection or extra automatic requests.
Diagnostic Perfetto cohort belongs to the withdrawn drawing candidate and is not combined with retained-runtime performance evidence.
Final production change is ClockRefresh only. TimedOverlay was restored byte-for-byte. No early injection or automatic retry.
Retained APK matches control4 and quiet-control clock byte-for-byte, including a failed default-short-wait observation; no claim that all waits or each sample passed.
No new true-device or hour soak measurement. Existing long-drift unit/functional regressions are not a repeated hour soak.
Raw large files remain local in ignored .tools. No commit or push performed.
